rows.text: The release dated 30 May 2019 states that the President of India has appointed Shri Narendra Damodardas Modi to be the Prime Minister of India, and lists the ministers appointed on his advice.

The same communique is headed 'President administers oath of office and secrecy to Prime Minister and other members of Union Council of Ministers' and states that the President administered the oaths of office and secrecy to the above members of the Council of Ministers, headed by Narendra Modi's appointment as Prime Minister, at a ceremony in Rashtrapati Bhavan 'today (30.05.2019)'.
